notes.title: Releasing my Second Game - Two Climbers
notes.notes:
Hey, It's Rombo.

I've just released my second game, Two Climbers!

It's a game where you and a buddy work together, to climb a mountain.
The game is a puzzle platformer game, with an emphasis on the platforming, utilising a new teamwork system where you and a friend can perform actions together, to climb to new heights!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366896/6c9fd994a42964154ce7e57c464a00c30ca4daf0.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2590080/Two_Climbers/

Thank you for your support!
I hope to see you again in the future!

notes.title: Friend Pass being removed
notes.notes:
I'm sorry to announce that the friend pass for the game has been removed.
I attempted to create one to allow for a second player to join for free but encountered some issues preventing it from working.
The fix for this issue is much larger than I am currently capable of solving alone.

I've chosen to half the current price of the game, to allow users to be able to purchase two copies of the game for the same price as before.
